_about: B4.1 — decisions on the 46 wger videos re-encoded to H.264 MP4 (scripts/catalog/convert-videos.mjs), made after LOOKING at three frames of each (video-check/converted strips, 2026-10-24; vid 37 at six frames). All are CC BY-SA 4.0 (uploader 'Goulart'). Rules: the video must show THIS exercise (a different variation is moved to its own exercise with moveTo, or rejected); no third party recognisable (a bystander's face clearly visible at display size, a readable licence plate, an advertising poster with faces); several clips of the same camera angle keep one. Personality rights of the demonstrators themselves are NOT covered by CC — owner confirmation before hosting (B4_MEDIA_RIGHTS_AND_QA §6).
